gameplay.asset_lifecycle: Warranties and capital replacement forecasts link to canonical equipment assets.
gameplay.defects: Equipment-linked condition defects carry severity, operational impact, safety implications, urgency and temporary controls.
gameplay.finance_boundary: No invoices, payments, cost ledger, rent or capital commitments are posted; BP-34 owns financial records.
gameplay.maintenance: Plans and cycles cover every building; inspections cover every building system and every property site.
gameplay.population: No residents, employees, contractors-as-persons or other person records are created.
gameplay.repairs: Open defects create linked work requests, orders, trade requirements, material records and lifecycle events.
